voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.22 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Two in the morning, I got a work order to cut the power to one house. Last street in the colonia.
lines.beat_before: hook: the phone at branch height in the work light: a man's face among feathers, tipping its head

lines.text: A neighbour was waiting by the pole. She didn't say a word. She just pointed up, into the tree.
lines.beat_before: the colonia street; then the neighbour under the sodium lamp, pointing up into the tree

lines.text: I went up in the bucket, filming. I thought it was the biggest owl I'd ever seen. Then it turned to the light. It had a man's face.
lines.beat_before: the bucket rising into the canopy; the work light swings onto a hunched feathered back

lines.text: It wasn't finished changing. Those were still a man's legs. And everywhere the feathers were coming through... the skin was splitting open.
lines.beat_before: its head swivels round to the light: a man's face, held

lines.text: I drove off with the bucket still up. On my phone there's a second video. I didn't take it. It's from the branch. Looking down at my truck.
lines.beat_before: the arms unfold into wings far too long; the phone falls
